keywords: Academic support system 2.Career management 3.Academic writing 4.Self-reflection 5.Academic adviser
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to improve further the skills learned in Basic Style for Study A (and other courses) from the first semester in KIT. After completing this course, you will be able to develop critical and logical thinking skills that enable you to put yourself into a social context and see yourself from the perspective of a third person, which is necessary to continue on the path to a meaningful and successful career.
advice: 1. “Weekly report”: Making good use of KIT’s academic support system to practice self-management. 2. “Newspaper portfolio”: Raising interest in social issues in terms of career management. 3. Special lecture on career management: Considering career management in the context of career development. 4. Group discussion and presentation: Becoming familiar with specialized courses for better career development. 5. Academic planning: Comprehending KIT’s educational curriculum and system in detail (such as prerequisites for course registration, graduation requirements, etc.) in terms of career management. 6. Short essay: Improving academic writing skills (including critical and logical thinking skills) by writing a Short essay. 7. Self-reflection: Group discussion and interview with the academic adviser to review the first year. *The submission date for each assignments must be strictly observed. *Access the “Student Portal”, “e-syllabus”, and other systems frequently to get the latest information *When submitting research papers and/or assignments, strictly adhere to the designated forms and instructions.
requiredKnowledge: 1. Willpower to understand and observe “KIT IDEALS.” 2. Willpower to understand and observe the “Student pledge.” 3. Willpower to acquire KIT human skills. 4. Motivation to develop language competence (in your native language). 5. Motivation to develop academic writing skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express your achievements and goals through weekly report and self-evaluation of achievement report.
Be able to organize the contents of special lectures accurately and express them in speech and writing.
Be able to find out problems in group discussions and express your opinions in speech and writing.
Be able to express your opinions of a social issue in academic writing (a short paper).
Be able to clarify in writing the academic planning of your course curriculum and future prospects in life.
Be able to develop and implement the skills necessary for students.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to create a “Weekly report” and describe your goals for the next week clearly. Be able to organize the contents of special lectures accurately and express them in speech and writing. Be able to express your opinions clearly in comparison with others in speech and writing. Be able to clarify your career design with a variety of interesting social issues and express them in academic writing. Be able to self-assess objectively and express clearly your achievements over the year.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to create a “Weekly report”. Be able to organize special lecture issues and summarize lecture contents. Be able to express your opinions in comparison with others in speech and writing. Be able to think of and express your career design in writing. Be able to self-assess and express your achievements over the year.
